model: the six-layer Tiny Instant-Only model (SM130): the head reads its frozen trunk (time heads for the family (SM117) recipe, head trained in the SM138 run); queries use show-time intervals (the package's INTEGRATION.md section 6.10)
answer_time: the answer time is the whole time on the card, front and back together: from the moment the question is shown to the moment a grade button is pressed, capped at the preset's maximum answer seconds (the revlog time). The moment 'Show answer' is pressed is not stored, so 'recall within S seconds' means recalled (Hard, Good or Easy) and answered within S s, reading the back included.
head: logits = out(relu(hidden(inputs))); inputs = 346 float32 values at the query (instant) row

inputs.intervals: show-time: the instant query row's interval runs from the card's previous answer to the moment the card is shown, floor(max(elapsed_seconds - duration / 1000, 0))

layout: layer_norm(x0) (64): the residual after the input encoder (features2card, after its SiLU)
layer_norm(x2) (64): after layer round 1 (step (1,1)) = the final residual before prehead_norm
head_p (128): relu(head_p.0(prehead_norm(x2))), the instant head's hidden layer
frozen.unit: a snapshot after each layer round of the interleaved schedule
frozen.layer_norm: no affine parameters, eps 1e-5, biased variance (torch.nn.functional.layer_norm)

explicit.source: the user's reviews before the query (card id, grade 1-4, duration ms) and the query's own card id and elapsed days
explicit.ln_time: ln(max(duration_ms, 1) / 1000) in float64; only durations > 0 are recorded
explicit.centre: ln times are centred on ln 8 s
explicit.median: exact running median (two heaps; even count = mean of the two middle values) per grade 1-4 of recorded times, fallback the median over all grades, then ln 8 s

output.layout: logits [4 grades (Again, Hard, Good, Easy) x 16 bins], softmax per grade
output.bins_meaning: bin 0 < 500 ms, bin k = [edge k-1, edge k), bin 15 >= 60 s (the time cap)
output.median: ln seconds, linear in ln time inside the crossing bin (bin 0 from ln 0.25 s, bin 15 = 60 s)
output.fast: P(answer under 3.891 s | grade) = sum of bins 0..6

valid: the query (instant) row of every review that is not the card's first (elapsed days >= 0, same-day reviews included: on show-time inputs the instant row does not hold the review's own answer time); first reviews are not predicted
